gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-tirhut: Noto Sans Tirhuta keeps its terminals cut back, leaving big gaps, and its dominant x-height makes text feel open and easy-going. Almendra Display brings the ornate, literary heading, so paragraphs below flow without strain.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-vai: Flavors has diagonals as hefty as its stems and a towering x-height, whimsical and commanding in equal measure. Noto Sans Vai stands out for generous space between curve ends and stems.
gen-eater-gf-oxygen: Eater looks dark and aggressive, its thin strokes hairline-free, its letters spaced wide apart, its ascenders short. Oxygen keeps curves open and lowercase near capital height, so reading flows along smoothly.
gen-eater-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Wide gaps between letters and short ascenders give Eater its dark, aggressive stance. Schibsted Grotesk then supplies big open bowls and terminals that never close in, giving the eye a steady counterweight.
gen-flavors-gf-sarpanch: Towering x-height and diagonals as hefty as the stems give Flavors a whimsical, commanding look. Sarpanch sits below with an open-mouthed lowercase e, while Flavors earns its keep big and short.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-modi: Almendra Display gives ornate, literary heading letters that never seem to pinch shut. And Noto Sans Modi lets daylight into every curve, with little gap between capital and body height.
gen-audiowide-gf-sen: Tile-like glyphs with wide grout lines give Audiowide its futuristic look. Sen stands beside it with lowercase built tall and a constant-weight line tracing each letter, a modern foil to the techy heading.
gen-eater-gf-sintony: Dark and aggressive, Eater spaces its letters wide and keeps its ascenders short. But Sintony has a chunky, tall midzone and smooth curves, so whole paragraphs read smoothly without clogging.
gen-flavors-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans reads in smooth, unmodulated lines with open rounded letters. Flavors is best when its towering x-height and hefty diagonals take command, whereas Sofia Sans is best when lowercase stands tall in steady rows.
gen-audiowide-gf-sono: Audiowide moves with pen-plotter smoothness, futuristic and tech to its core. Sono lays wide default spacing and an ajar lowercase a beneath it, giving the heading a friendlier partner on the page.
